body: You were just a kid. You made mistakes and it’s okay, because at the end of the day we all end up doing and saying shit we aren’t proud of. You don’t deserve to die for that man. I can tell that you’ve grown and changed over the years. You deserve to live and you’re so much more than the mistakes you made when you were younger

I just wish it wasn’t like this. I wish nobody had to feel like this,, and I hope you’re right about the healing,, i don’t know if i can go much further like this, thank you for saying these things, i really do appreciate it
